comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper opening stop versus seat a switch line card by closing two ejector levers together.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial driver-and-wrench countertorque; the line-card task requires synchronized bilateral levering against connector resistance while avoiding card cocking.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained angular calibration through cycles; the card task requires both end gaps within 1 mm, both levers latched, release, and no damaging end-gap mismatch.
comparison.reason: Synchronized connector seating and latch closure differ from preserving an adjustable threaded setting, despite both being bimanual robot-hardware service tasks.
